6592.d: Öises maastikus, ees paremal veekogu paadiga ja kahe sõudjaga. Vasakul kaldavõsa. Tagapool, keskel, kuust valgustatud loss.
6592.de: In a night landscape, in front on the right a body of water with a boat and two rowers. On the left shoreline brush. Further back, in the centre, a castle lit by the moon.

7671.d: Eest paremalt taha vasakule kaljude vahele voolav jõeke. Tagapool kaljuseid vastaskaldaid ühendav puust kaarjas sild suunaga vasakult paremalt. Üksikute inimfiguuridega sellel ja ees. Paremal vastakaldal üksikuid kuuski.
7671.de: A stream flowing from front right to back left between cliffs. Further back, a wooden arched bridge connecting the rocky opposite banks, running from left to right. With individual human figures on it and in front. On the right bank a few solitary spruces.

7825.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale, pilk suunatud paremale. Rinnas krooniga order monogrammiga.
7825.de: Bust of a man in half-profile to the left, gaze directed to the right. On his chest an order with a crown and monogram.

8280.d: Ees vasakul joonia stiilis monumendi vare. Selle juures 3 inimfiguuri. Paremal, poollängu kasvanud lehtpuu- Keskel, järve kaldal kitse kari ja üksik ratsanik. Taamal kaljuplatool sammasehitiste (templite) varemed.
8280.de: In the foreground on the left, the ruin of an Ionic-style monument. Beside it 3 human figures. On the right, a deciduous tree grown at a slant. In the centre, on the lake shore, a herd of goats and a lone rider. In the distance on a rocky plateau, the ruins of columned buildings (temples).
